# Levo Box

> Authorized Brother reseller (Reseller Resmi Brother) in Makassar, South Sulawesi, Indonesia, selling Brother printers, original and compatible Brother ink and toner, TATA binding and punching machines, Brother label makers and photo paper. Orders are shipped across Indonesia.

- Address: Jl. Bacan No. 5, Ende, Kecamatan Wajo, Makassar 90174, Sulawesi Selatan, Indonesia
- Opening hours: Monday–Saturday 08:30–16:30 WITA
- WhatsApp: +62 895-4127-55181
- Languages: Indonesian (main site), English

## Pages

- [Levo Box (Indonesian)](https://levobox.com/): printers, ink and toner, label makers and photo paper, TATA binding machines, prices and FAQ
- [Levo Box (English)](https://levobox.com/en/): the same catalogue in English
- [Tinta Brother (Indonesian)](https://levobox.com/tinta-brother/): Brother ink compatibility chart (printer model → ink), page yields, prices and ink FAQ

## Product range

- Brother laser printers: DCP-L2540DW, MFC-L2700D
- Brother ink: LC583, LC535XL / LC539XL, LC462, LC3617, LC400, BT-D60 / BT5000, plus XPOSÉ compatible refill ink and refillable cartridges
- Brother P-touch label makers (D200, 90) and M-series tape
- XPOSÉ A4 glossy photo paper
- TATA binding and punching machines: HP-2, HAMBURG, KASSEL, e-WIRO-31, E-BIND, Drill Punch P-2 and P-3

Each product shows its current shop price; where a second, struck-through price appears, that is a reference price. Stock and final prices are confirmed via WhatsApp or in store.
